title: 第十九章 小智等人的来到第二十章 激战巨大快龙
content_zh:
在正辉灯塔的海边，林萧给小精灵们放了三天假，任由它们玩闹，休养生息。
第四天如期而来的训练开始了。
穿着沙滩裤，林萧准备对小精灵们做进一步的训练。
“首先是卡咪龟，体力和耐力仍是你的第一训练方针，等下你就抱着石块在沙滩上跑步明白吗？”
卡咪龟用力的点点头，屁颠屁颠的找了块石头抱着开始跑步，沙滩上抱着石头跑步很难，一脚下去就是一个坑，很消耗体力，而随时会摔倒，刚跑出几步的卡咪龟不石英沙滩的柔软，栽了个大跟头，弄得一头一脸的沙子，让芽衣和藤藤蛇娇笑不已。
“班吉拉就侧重学习一些格斗系技能吧，你有身体的天赋，使用格斗技能威力很大。”林萧拿出准备好的气球加满气递给班吉拉，“今天就练习百万吨拳击和百万吨飞踢吧，这两个技能你经常在用，但是不到火候，什么时候能把半空的气球打爆、踢爆就差不多了，我会让芽衣帮助你扔气球的。”
班吉拉和辅助人员芽衣到一旁开始训练，班吉拉的任务可不轻，气球这玩意轻轻一碰就飞的老远，力量太大时拳头还没打中，气球就已经被拳风吹到一旁。想要一拳打爆空中的气球对力量速度的控制要求很高，林萧也是为了这点才会让班吉拉如此练习。
“快龙你等会在沙滩上用急冻光线制作一个冰屋，然后坐在里面。恩......睡觉或是打坐都可以，你自己选择就好，我会让从正辉博士哪里借来的迷唇姐对冰屋进行降温。龙系小精灵一直被冰系克制，这是你现在最大的缺点，这方面需要加强知道吗？”
“呜~”快龙轻叫着，严肃的点点头，制作冰屋去了。
被冰系克制可说是龙系小精灵最大的无奈了，既然改不了被克的命运，那么只有从身体抵抗方面下手了，努力提高对冰属性的抵抗。
炎帝虽然也被水系和冰系克，但林萧可不会像个sb一样让它也去冰屋里睡觉。
“炎帝，”林萧指着一块被海浪冲刷的岩石道：“等下你站到那块岩石上去，用火焰围城一个圈把自己包裹住让海浪冲击。记住火焰圈不能太厚，也不能太薄，这样做不仅能锻炼你控制火焰的力度，还能让你压缩自己的火焰，努力争取把火升级为温度更高的蓝色火焰和黑色火焰。”至于金色的就别想了，那是凤王的专利。
炎帝发出一阵低吼，示意自己明白，几个跃步就跳上了岩石，用深红色的火焰在身体周围部成一个圆圈。
随着海浪的冲刷，炎帝身上不断的响起“滋，滋”的声音，大量的水蒸气缓缓飘起，在阳光的照射下形成一道靓丽的彩虹，炎帝蹲在彩虹的下方，用火焰圈抵抗海浪的冲击。
藤藤蛇和它的主人芽衣一样不喜欢战斗，林萧索性让它继续在海滩上玩耍。不过小家伙也不是省心的料。没人陪它玩耍，无聊透顶的藤藤蛇开始捣乱。
芽衣刚把气球扔起来，班吉拉使出百万吨拳击，可还没打到气球，一片树叶飞过来把气球切成了两半。
班吉拉一拳打到了空处，心里郁闷不已，朝藤藤蛇咆哮，让它走远点玩，别耽误自己训练，芽衣同样对藤藤蛇指责一番。
委屈的藤藤蛇，溜达到了卡咪龟跑步的地方围着它打转，被分心的卡咪龟顿时连翻几个跟头。怒火冲天的卡咪龟差点把手中的石头扔到藤藤蛇的脑袋上。
被卡咪龟下了一跳的藤藤蛇，无精打采的来到炎帝身后，一道海浪打来差点把它卷到了海里。还好炎帝用爪子拉了一把，炎帝没想到的是藤藤蛇被自己爪子上的火焰烫起几个大水泡，抱着屁股上串下跳。
这一幕让林萧哭笑不得，只好帮它上烧伤药，让它和自己一起跑步才安静下来。

就这样林萧对小精灵进行各种训练，同时等待小智的到来。动漫的剧情林萧还能记住的寥寥无几，所以只能得带剧情任务小智的到来。
一眨眼，十多天时间悄然而过，小精灵们的训练都取得了不错的结果。其中炎帝的变化最大，火焰的颜色已经开始向蓝色转变。
就在林萧已经等得不耐烦时，小智三人组才慢悠悠的来到海边。这是要多逆天的方向感才能做出这种在森林里迷路十几天的事迹。
芽衣不停的询问林萧为什么还不走，弄得林萧每天寻找各种理由打发芽衣，随着三人的到来，林萧差点激动的留下了眼泪，妹的！老子这一等可是足足的登了14天！！
担忧自己的大钳蟹会不会被大木博士煮来吃的小智，看到林萧等人也在这里，激动得大喊：“林萧哥！”
一声“林萧哥”差点让林萧一头栽死在沙滩上，芽衣想笑，但被林萧瞪了一眼后连忙捂住自己的小嘴，只是一张憋得通红的小脸和抖动的肩膀出卖了她的行为。
满头黑线的林萧搂住小智的肩膀，开始教导他，“小智啊，以后呢这林萧哥就不能叫了，你干脆喊我大哥吧。不，以后叫我林萧就行知道吗？”
小智丝毫不买账，把头要得跟拨浪鼓一样，“不行，那样的话我会被老妈骂死的，绝不对行。”
content_en:
At the beach of Zhenghui Lighthouse, Lin Xiao gave the elves a three-day holiday, allowing them to play and recuperate.
The fourth day of training started as scheduled.
Wearing beach pants, Lin Xiao prepared to further train the elves.
"First of all, Cammy Turtle, physical strength and endurance are still your first training goals. You will be holding rocks and running on the beach later, do you understand?"
Kami Turtle nodded vigorously, found a stone and started running. It was difficult to run with a stone on the beach. It was a pit when you stepped down, which was very energy-consuming and could fall down at any time. The Kami Turtle, who had just run a few steps, was not as soft as the quartz beach. He fell over and fell over, covering his head and face with sand, which made Mei Yi and Teng Teng Snake laugh endlessly.
"Banjila, just focus on learning some fighting skills. You have physical talent, and the fighting skills are very powerful." Lin Xiao took out the prepared balloon, filled it with air and handed it to Bangila, "Today, practice megaton boxing and megaton flying kick. You often use these two skills, but when the heat is low, it will be enough if you can pop or kick the balloon in mid-air. I will let Mei Yi help you throw the balloon."
Bangila and the support staff Meiyi went aside to start training. Bangila's task was not light. The balloon flew far away with just a touch. When the force was too strong, the balloon was blown aside by the wind before the fist hit it. Wanting to pop a balloon in the air with one punch requires very high control of strength and speed, and it was for this reason that Lin Xiao asked Bangila to practice like this.
"Kailong, you will use the freezing light to make an igloo on the beach later, and then sit in it. Well... you can sleep or meditate, you can choose. I will let Sister Mizui borrowed from Dr. Zhenghui cool down the igloo. The dragon-type elves have always been restrained by the ice-type. This is your biggest shortcoming now. You need to strengthen this aspect, you know?"
"Woo~" Kuailong shouted softly, nodded seriously, and went to make an igloo.
Being restrained by the ice element can be said to be the biggest helplessness of the dragon element elf. Since there is no way to change the fate of being restrained, the only way is to start with physical resistance and work hard to improve the resistance to the ice element.
Although Emperor Yan was also defeated by the water and ice elements, Lin Xiao would not let him sleep in an igloo like a sb.
"Fire Emperor," Lin Xiao pointed to a rock washed by the waves and said: "Wait a minute, stand on that rock, wrap yourself in a circle of flames and let the waves hit. Remember that the flame circle can't be too thick, nor too thin. This will not only exercise your ability to control the flames, but also allow you to compress your own flames and strive to upgrade the fire to higher-temperature blue flames and black flames." As for the golden ones, don't even think about them, that's the Phoenix King's patent.
Emperor Yan let out a low roar to indicate that he understood, and jumped onto the rock in a few leaps, using crimson flames to form a circle around his body.
As the waves washed away, Emperor Yan kept making sounds of "Zi, Zhi", and a large amount of water vapor slowly floated up, forming a beautiful rainbow under the sunlight. Emperor Yan squatted under the rainbow and used a circle of flame to resist the impact of the waves.
The Vine Snake, like its owner Mei Yi, didn't like fighting, so Lin Xiao simply let it continue to play on the beach. But the little guy is not easy material. With no one to play with, the bored snake began to cause trouble.
As soon as Mei threw the balloon up, Bangela used a megaton punch, but before it could hit the balloon, a leaf flew over and cut the balloon in half.
Bangila punched the empty space, feeling depressed, and roared at the Vine Snake, telling it to go away and play, and not to delay his training. Mei Yi also criticized the Vine Snake.
The aggrieved Vine Snake wandered over to the place where Cammy Turtle was running and circled around it. The distracted Cammy Turtle immediately turned somersaults. The angry Cammy turtle almost threw the stone in his hand at the vineOn the head of the vine snake.
The Vine Snake, which was jumped by Cammy Turtle, came listlessly behind Emperor Yan, and was almost swept into the sea by a wave of waves. Fortunately, Emperor Yan pulled it with his claws. What Emperor Yan didn't expect was that the vine snake was scalded by the flames on its claws and had several big blisters, and it jumped up and down holding its buttocks.
This scene made Lin Xiao dumbfounded, so he had to give it burn medicine and let it run with him before it calmed down.
In this way, Lin Xiao conducted various trainings on the elves while waiting for Xiaozhi's arrival. Lin Xiao could only remember very little of the plot of the anime, so he had to bring about the plot mission of Xiaozhi's arrival.
In the blink of an eye, more than ten days passed quietly, and the elves' training achieved good results. Among them, Emperor Yan has changed the most, and the color of the flame has begun to change to blue.
Just when Lin Xiao was getting impatient with waiting, the trio of Xiaozhi slowly came to the beach. It takes an incredible sense of direction to be able to get lost in the forest for more than ten days.
Meiyi kept asking Lin Xiao why he still didn't leave, causing Lin Xiao to find various reasons to beat Meiyi every day. With the arrival of the three people, Lin Xiao almost cried with excitement, girl! I have been waiting for 14 days! !
Xiaozhi, who was worried whether his giant claw crab would be cooked and eaten by Dr. Omu, saw Lin Xiao and others here and shouted excitedly: "Brother Lin Xiao!"
The cry of "Brother Lin Xiao" almost made Lin Xiao fall headfirst onto the beach. Yayi wanted to laugh, but Lin Xiao glared at her and quickly covered her mouth. However, her flushed face and trembling shoulders betrayed her behavior.
Lin Xiao, who had black lines all over his head, put his arm around Xiaozhi's shoulders and began to teach him, "Xiaozhi, from now on, you can't call me brother Lin Xiao. You can just call me big brother. No, just call me Lin Xiao from now on, okay?"
Xiaozhi didn't buy it at all, and shook his head like a rattle, "No, my mother will scold me to death. It's never right."
